newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Inco up 31.45 percent on buy-back reports.
newsitem.headline: Inco up 31.45 percent on buy-back reports.

text.p: Shares of PT International Nickel Indonesia (Inco) rose 31.45 percent in early Thursday trading on newspaper reports the firm planned to buy back about 20 percent of its stock on the market, brokers said.
Inco rose 975 rupiah to 4,075 rupiah after 75 minutes of trading, with volume approaching 600,000 shares.
"Reports on the buy-back plan prompted players to buy Inco," one broker said.

Inco's president and chief executive officer Rumengan Musu said after a shareholders meeting on Tuesday that the firm planned to buy back about 20 percent of its stock, Bisnis Indonesia newspaper said.
Musu, however, said the Capital Market Supervisory Agency (Bapepam) had not yet approved the proposed buy back.
